correctness.rationale: Reconstructed affine partial derivatives f_x=1+a^r(k-b), f_y=a^{r+1}-b^r and rational-point parametrization t=b/a; no infinity singularity from line derivative. Frobenius translation produces zero coefficients below degree min(s,q)+1; for s<q tangent slope roots of z^{s+1}-z+t^{-N} are squarefree; for s>q U^q V-U V^q gives q+1 rational directions; at s=q derivative of P_h,lambda has unique repeated-root candidate and condition h²+lambda(h+1)=0. Independently factored mod 5 exceptional witness (p,q,r,t)=(5,5,5,3) as one simple plus one 5-fold tangent, and mod 3 (3,3,3,1) as one 4-fold tangent; distinguishes repeated tangent from unknown analytic branch number. Only rational singular points are classified.
